There is a reason this game will be 20 years old next year and is still bomin'. I've been playing tf2 on and of since 2017 (mind you the game was already 10 years old at that point) and it is still the game I always come back too every year, many times per year. And ever since the bot problem was fixed (almost) I can actually play casual instead of just uncle dane servers. It is a master piece, the representation of how FUN fps games can be. Although many have tried, this is still the best game in it's genre. Also, it's free. So try it. You will easily discover why it is so many people's favourite game.
